name: red-02-final-tests-head
purpose: U040 RED re-archived on the FINAL tests against the HEAD bytes of server.cjs (commit a52f05e2, git blob d99e9bdf12d5f35d7389ec0f72dac6a3983fae19, sha256 22f6db29...). red-01 ran the first version of the tests; GREEN showed one flaw in a test (the 5 ms two-write form asserted the refusal answer, but the client's own late write can make the OS reset the connection before the answer is read), so the form now only requires that the answers are a prefix of the expected ones, a fresh-connection control and a 50-request flood test were added. red-01 stays archived unchanged. Run in place with the HEAD bytes of server.cjs temporarily restored (the fixed bytes were saved outside the repository and restored afterwards; the recorded input hash of server.cjs proves which bytes ran).
